# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon expands bullishly with increasing separation and price breaks above the prior swing high, momentum tends to continue. This edge exists because a bullish ribbon alignment (5-EMA > 8-EMA > 13-EMA) with expanding width indicates strengthening short-term momentum, and a break of prior swing high confirms the trend acceleration.

## Mechanism

Entry: Enter long when 5-EMA > 8-EMA > 13-EMA (bullish ribbon alignment) AND the distance between 5-EMA and 13-EMA exceeds its 20-bar average (ribbon expansion) AND price closes above the previous bar’s high (or prior swing high identified by a higher high) AND volume > 1.3 × the 20-bar average volume.  
Exit: Initial stop at the low of the breakout bar (chart-stop), target 1.5R, then trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR × 3) or a 0.5% premium stop.
